newsitems.title: PGS 7: Tournament Recap
newsitems.author: Eoin
newsitems.contents:
[p][i]With PGS 7 in the rear view mirror, we caught up with our PGS reporter Jisooboy to get their expert insights on why the tournament unfolded in the way it did![/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/cad4164a0390246832335c787e7cb235a8cc0487.png"][/img][/p][p][i]​[/i][/p][p][u]"Life is C(Choice) between B(Birth) and D(Death)."[/u][/p][p] [/p][p]I brought a famous quote to kick things off. In PUBG, players land with bare hands, but the outcome is ultimately determined by the choices they make. On the perilous boundary between life and death, players have always carved out their own destiny through those crucial choices.[/p][p]​[/p][p]Numerous factors are considered when making these decisions, but the most critical of all is undoubtedly the [b]Blue Zone[/b]. Whether you are a casual player or a pro, preferred drop zones or cities may shift depending on the [b]flight path[/b] (plane trajectory). However, no one can predict where the Blue Zone will shrink once everyone hits the ground. Thus, navigating the Blue Zone has always been a realm of experience and intuition, never of absolute certainty.[/p][p] [/p][p]Particularly, the classic Blue Zone settings we were all accustomed to underwent a massive overhaul with the [b]Update 42.1 Patch[/b] on June 16, 2026. The durations of the early and final phases were shortened, the overall size of the safe zones was reduced, and the Blue Zone damage scale shifted from a distance-based system to a cumulative time-spent system. Most importantly, the land-prioritization algorithm that assisted safe zone generation was completely removed.[/p][p] [/p][p]Due to this monumental shift, teams that traditionally relied on "circle-reading" and strategic macro-play as their primary strengths have struggled significantly. Strategic powerhouses like [b]DN SOOPERS, Team Vitality, and Team Falcons[/b] were pushed to the brink, finding themselves relegated from the Group Stage to the Survival Stage. Although they eventually clawed their way into the Final Stage, none of them walked away with results they could truly be satisfied with.[/p][p] [/p][p]This crisis was not unique to macro-heavy teams either. Even squads renowned for their raw skirmishing power and gunplay, such as [b]T1 and Natus Vincere[/b], failed to even qualify for the Final Stage. While we witnessed numerous moments where players were picked off while rotating under time pressure, the shrink in the initial Blue Zone's area also created clear pressure points where teams were forced to make high-stakes decisions much faster than before.[/p][p] [/p][p]Specifically, as the [b]Phase 4 Blue Zone[/b]—which heavily dictates the momentum of any match—introduced a higher degree of randomness, the historical circle-prediction data used by many teams has been completely rewritten. Let's look at a concrete example.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/64f07c12976def7e620a695dd8f149c6b024ec5c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/aecf08ffa5cc12077a6290c8a160b388899e8a97.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]The Blue Zone behavior we previously knew is illustrated in [b]\[Attachment 1][/b]. Especially when the circle pulled over water or rivers, it was essential for teams to analyze the ratio of land—which had a higher probability of pulling the next circle away from the water—to predict Phase 4 and preemptively seize high-tier compounds or defensive ridges. In that meta, certain spots were classified as highly reliable, go-to strongholds for mid-to-late game macro, earning them the nickname "Science" because teams could blind-drop or rotate into them without a second thought.[/p][p] [/p][p]However, with this Blue Zone reform patch, it is safe to say those "scientific rules" have vanished. Formulaic circle patterns have disappeared, and highly volatile, unpredictable circles have emerged. Consequently, the strategic value of early-centering or rushing to secure a central compound has been somewhat diluted. As shown in [b]\[Attachment 2][/b], despite the heavy presence of water, a massive portion of the sea remains engulfed inside the active safe zone.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Match Survival Statistics (At the 10-Minute Mark)[/h3][p]Furthermore, as the early-phase Blue Zone times were cut short and their areas reduced, players' rotation paths frequently overlapped. This has had a direct impact on the match survival rate. Below is the compiled data:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/9293855a6854b38e85dcc163e98cfd59db465188.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][i]GS: Group Stage / WS: Winners Stage / SS: Survival Stage / FS: Final Stage / GF: Grand Final[/i][/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]To conduct this data analysis, I reviewed every single match across all previous PGS iterations, manually counting and recording the number of active players surviving at the exact 10-minute mark.[/p][p] [/p][p]While the current sample size under the new Blue Zone settings is still somewhat limited, the rule change has clearly driven a statistically significant drop in early-game survival numbers. Overall, the survival rate has decreased. Notably, we observed a massive drop-off in survivor counts during the [b]Final Stage[/b] and on the map [b]Rondo[/b]. Given the high-stakes nature of the Final Stage compared to the Group, Winners, or Survival Stages, combined with Rondo's incredibly vast terrain, we saw several teams in PGS 7 opt for highly aggressive, early rotations or make high-risk, high-reward gambles.[/p][p] [/p][p]This survival drop was not uniform across all stages and maps. By stage, the Group Stage actually saw a slight increase in survival, while the Winners and Survival Stages showed a minor drop of about 2 players. However, in the [b]Final Stage, the survival rate plummeted by 5.4 players[/b]. This data suggests that the new Blue Zone doesn't simply force early engagements across the board; rather, its impact is amplified dramatically on specific maps and during higher-stakes stages.[/p][p] [/p][p]Of course, a holistic analysis must account for several other variables. We must examine qualitative factors that cannot be captured by raw data alone—such as the specific map pool, participating team rosters, team-specific tactical playstyles and tendencies, [b]hot-drop/landmark conflicts[/b], starting flight paths, Phase 1 circle shapes, and stage-specific lobby dynamics. While PGS 7 is the only tournament played under the updated Blue Zone rules so far, we will undoubtedly secure more reliable data and stronger statistical significance once PGS 8 and PGS 9 are concluded.[/p][p] [/p][p]PUBG Esports athletes are constantly fighting for survival, chasing the clock under extreme pressure. At times, they are forced into unavoidable compromises, and they often fall victim to incredibly unforgiving circle shifts. Nonetheless, the beauty of PUBG Esports is that these players will adapt, and today's defeated squad can easily become tomorrow's champion. Survival or elimination—on that knife-edge boundary, which team do you think will make the ultimate winning choice?[/p][p] [/p][p]- Jisooboy[/p][p]
[/p]

The champions of PGS 7 and PGS 8 will earn 60 points each, while the PGS 9 champion will earn 120 points.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,,"][tr][th][p]Final Placement[/p][p][/p][/th][th][p]PGS 7[/p][p][/p][/th][th][p]PGS 8[/p][p][/p][/th][th][p]PGS 9[/p][p][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]1st [/p][/td][td][p]60 [/p][/td][td][p]60 [/p][/td][td][p]120 [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]2nd [/p][/td][td][p]48 [/p][/td][td][p]48 [/p][/td][td][p]96 [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]3rd [/p][/td][td][p]40 [/p][/td][td][p]40 [/p][/td][td][p]80 [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]4th [/p][/td][td][p]34 [/p][/td][td][p]34 [/p][/td][td][p]68 [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]5th [/p][/td][td][p]30 [/p][/td][td][p]30 [/p][/td][td][p]60 [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]6th [/p][/td][td][p]26 [/p][/td][td][p]26 [/p][/td][td][p]52 [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]7th [/p][/td][td][p]22 [/p][/td][td][p]22 [/p][/td][td][p]44 [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]8th [/p][/td][td][p]18 [/p][/td][td][p]18 [/p][/td][td][p]36 [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]9th [/p][/td][td][p]14 [/p][/td][td][p]14 [/p][/td][td][p]28 [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]10th [/p][/td][td][p]10 [/p][/td][td][p]10 [/p][/td][td][p]20 [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]11th [/p][/td][td][p]8 [/p][/td][td][p]8 [/p][/td][td][p]16 [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]12th [/p][/td][td][p]6 [/p][/td][td][p]6 [/p][/td][td][p]12 [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]13th [/p][/td][td][p]4 [/p][/td][td][p]4 [/p][/td][td][p]8 [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]14th–16th [/p][/td][td][p]2 [/p][/td][td][p]2 [/p][/td][td][p]4 [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]17th–24th [/p][/td][td][p]0 [/p][/td][td][p]0 [/p][/td][td][p]0 [/p][/td][/tr][/table][p align="start"]PGS Points are awarded only to the top 16 teams in each series. At the end of PGS 12, the top eight teams in the annual PGS Points standings will qualify directly for PGC 2026.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]For the teams that built an advantage in the first half, Shanghai is where they must defend it. For those chasing from behind, the doubled points create an opportunity to turn the standings around. One strong circuit could reshape the entire PGC race.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Map Pool and Order[/h2][p align="start"]Circuit 3 will be played across Erangel, Miramar, Taego, and Rondo.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,,,,"][tr][th][p]Stage[/p][p][/p][/th][th][p]Match 1[/p][p][/p][/th][th][p]Match 2[/p][p][/p][/th][th][p]Match 3[/p][p][/p][/th][th][p]Match 4[/p][p][/p][/th][th][p]Match 5[/p][p][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]Group Stage [/p][/td][td][p]Erangel [/p][/td][td][p]Miramar [/p][/td][td][p]Taego [/p][/td][td][p]— [/p][/td][td][p]— [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Winners / Survival / Final Day 1 / Grand Finals Days 1 & 3 [/p][/td][td][p]Erangel [/p][/td][td][p]Miramar [/p][/td][td][p]Taego [/p][/td][td][p]Rondo [/p][/td][td][p]Erangel [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Final Day 2 / Grand Finals Day 2 [/p][/td][td][p]Taego [/p][/td][td][p]Erangel [/p][/td][td][p]Rondo [/p][/td][td][p]Miramar [/p][/td][td][p]Taego [/p][/td][/tr][/table][p align="start"]The Group Stage repeats the same Erangel → Miramar → Taego order across all three group matchups for Matches 1 through 9.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Prize Pool[/h2][p align="start"]The total prize pool for Circuit 3 is $500,000, distributed across the three series.[/p][list][*][p]PGS 7: $100,000 — $30,000 for the champion[/p][/*][*][p]PGS 8: $100,000 — $30,000 for the champion[/p][/*][*][p]PGS 9: $300,000 — $100,000 for the champion[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Placement prizes will be awarded to the top eight teams in PGS 7 and PGS 8, and to all 16 Grand Finalists in PGS 9. Each series also features separate match-win and MVP prizes.[/p][p align="start"]Across four circuits and 12 series, the total prize pool for the 2026 PGS season is $2,000,000.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]How to Watch[/h2][p align="start"]All PGS 7–9 matches will be broadcast live on official PUBG Esports channels.[/p][p align="start"]Matches begin at 10:00 UTC daily, except for the PGS 7 Group Stage on August 5, which begins at 05:00 UTC.[/p][p align="start"]Detailed broadcast channels and viewing links will be announced separately.[/p][p align="start"]A new city, double the points, and 24 teams fighting for their place at PGC 2026. Circuit 3 will set the direction for the second half of the 2026 season.[/p][p align="start"]See you in Shanghai on August 5![/p]

newsitems.title: PUBG: Playgrounds – Discover and Play Community-Created Experiences
newsitems.author: yolosonson
newsitems.contents:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="RwRFcVTdSeQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Hello players![/p][p]With the August Update, [b]PUBG: Playgrounds[/b] is arriving as a new home where even more players can discover and enjoy community-created modes together.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/a085d26eba4dfc6a9c8c5a21b44cb8f1a6a153c9.jpg"][/img]  [/p][h3]Developer’s Comment[/h3][p]Until now, players have been able to create their own modes through the UGC Alpha feature in Custom Match. However, playing those creations with others required creators to gather people themselves and invite them to a Custom Match, making it difficult for their modes to reach a broader audience.[/p][p]It was also difficult to browse modes created by other players, which made community-created content less accessible overall.[/p][p]With this update, the feature is being expanded into PUBG: Playgrounds. Popular and entertaining player-created modes will be selected and featured on a dedicated page, where players can jump straight into them through matchmaking. Our goal is to make PUBG: Playgrounds easier to access and use, while giving creators even more motivation to build great modes.[/p][p]The modes available through PUBG: Playgrounds will be updated monthly. We plan to source modes through a variety of channels and continue introducing new creations with each update.[/p][p] [/p][h2][b]■ Information for Mode Creators[/b][/h2][h3][b]How Modes Are Added to PUBG: Playgrounds[/b][/h3][p]Direct mode submissions are not currently supported. Instead, the developers will select modes based on gameplay data collected from Custom Matches.[/p][p]We will provide a separate announcement should the submission or registration process change in the future.[/p][list][*][p][b]Play your mode in Custom Match[/b] — The more often your mode is played in Custom Match, the more gameplay data it will accumulate.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Developer review and selection[/b] — The developers will monitor a range of gameplay data, including total playtime and average participation rate, to identify popular modes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Addition to PUBG: Playgrounds[/b] — Modes that meet the required criteria based on monitoring results will be added to the PUBG: Playgrounds, allowing them to reach more players through matchmaking.[/p][/*][/list][p]In addition to selection based on gameplay data, modes may also be sourced and added through other channels, including community-created mode contests.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Mode Selection Restrictions[/b][/h3][p]Even popular modes may be excluded from PUBG: Playgrounds if any of the following conditions apply.[/p][p]Grounds for exclusion from PUBG: Playgrounds:[/p][list][*][p]The map itself contains content that violates the Rules of Conduct or the PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Mods Policy.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The mode contains a critical bug that prevents normal gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]The mode contains inappropriate text.[/p][/*][/list][p]A mode may remain available after the relevant content is removed from its description if the description contains:[/p][list][*][p]Links or website addresses used for commercial purposes, including advertising, sponsorships, or promotions.[/p][/*][*][p]Links to personal social media accounts or personal websites.[/p][/*][*][p]Information about a clan that the creator belongs to or operates.[/p][/*][*][p]Any other content that violates the Rules of Conduct or the PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Mods Policy.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3][b]Things to Keep in Mind When Creating a Mode[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Custom Match (Create) is available only to BATTLEGROUNDS PLUS accounts.[/p][/*][*][p]If no separate thumbnail is registered, an in-mode screenshot will automatically be used as the mode’s thumbnail.[/p][/*][*][p]Setting appropriate primary and secondary tags will help more players discover your mode.[/p][/*][*][p]If a community-created mode is selected and added to PUBG: Playgrounds, certain settings, such as the score limit or number of rounds, may be adjusted to ensure stable gameplay.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3][b]Policies and Support[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Mods Policy can be found under the Mods Policy tab at the link below.[/p][list][*][p][u][url="https://pubg.com/clause/"]View the PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Mods Policy[/url][/u][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]For questions related to modes, please contact [u][url="https://support.pubg.com/"]PUBG Support[/url][/u].[/p][/*][*][p]Any future changes to the PUBG: Playgrounds policy will be announced separately.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]■ Information for Mode Players[/b][/h2][h3](PC) PUBG: Playgrounds[/h3][p]The upcoming August Update will introduce PUBG: Playgrounds, a dedicated hub for community-created modes.[/p][list][*][p]You can access it through [b]\[PUBG: Playgrounds] under the \[Play] menu[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Browse the available modes at a glance, select the one you want, and start matchmaking right away.[/p][/*][*][p]PUBG: Playgrounds will be available on [b]PC[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3][b]Page Overview[/b][/h3][p] [/p][p][b]Main Page[/b][/p][p]When you enter the PUBG: Playgrounds menu, the main page will display a list of all currently available modes.[/p][list][*][p]You can view each mode’s name, primary tag, and thumbnail. Hovering over the information icon will display the following details:[/p][list][*][p]Mode name / Creator name[/p][/*][*][p]Primary and secondary tags[/p][/*][*][p]Maximum number of players / Maximum team size[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Page sections[/p][list][*][p]New: Displays recently added modes in a randomized order.[/p][list][*][p]This section will not appear when the service first launches. It will become available as more modes are added over time.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Recently Played: Displays modes you have played in PUBG: Playgrounds, with the most recently played modes shown first.[/p][/*][*][p]All: Displays all currently available modes in a randomized order.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Search and filters: Search by mode name or creator name, and filter modes by primary tag.[/p][/*][*][p]Selecting the Create button will take you to the Custom Match room creation screen.[/p][list][*][p]Create is available only to BATTLEGROUNDS PLUS accounts.  [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Mode Details Page[/b][/p][p]Selecting a mode will take you to its details page.[/p][list][*][p][b]Mode Information[/b][/p][list][*][p]Main image / Mode name / Mode type (tag) / Creator information[/p][/*][*][p]Number of rounds / Maximum number of players / Maximum team size / Perspective[/p][/*][*][p]Mode update information (including version and update date)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]You can view the detailed description provided by the creator and use the AI translation feature to read it in another language.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3][b]Matchmaking[/b][/h3][list][*][p]After selecting a mode, you can begin matchmaking from its details page.[/p][/*][*][p]A matchmaking session will remain active for up to 1 hour and 30 minutes.[/p][list][*][p]The session duration may be changed in the future.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]When switching between a community-created mode and Normal or Ranked Mode, the party may be automatically disbanded if the number of party members exceeds the maximum player count supported by the mode you are switching to.[/p][/*][*][p]To start a match directly through Custom Match, select Go to Custom Match or Create. (A BATTLEGROUNDS PLUS account is required. The preset, map, and maximum player count cannot be changed.)[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3][b]Tags[/b][/h3][p]Tags have been introduced to make it easier to categorize, discover, and search for modes.[/p][list][*][p]Primary tag: One required[/p][/*][*][p]Secondary tags: Zero to two may be selected (Primary tag-specific secondary tags / Shared secondary tags)[/p][/*][/list][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][th][p][b]Primary Tag[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]Primary Tag-Specific[/b]
[b]Secondary Tags[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]Shared Secondary Tags[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Battle (Team)[/b][/p][/td][td rowspan="2"][p]Team[/p][list][*][p]1v1[/p][/*][*][p]2v2[/p][/*][*][p]3v3[/p][/*][*][p]4v4[/p][/*][*][p]NvN[/p][/*][/list][/td][td rowspan="6"][p]Battle Royale[/p][list][*][p]Deathmatch[/p][/*][*][p]Conquest[/p][/*][*][p]Puzzle[/p][/*][*][p]Racing[/p][/*][*][p]Party[/p][/*][*][p]Defense[/p][/*][*][p]Gun Game[/p][/*][*][p]Wave[/p][/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Battle (Free-For-All)[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Training[/b][/p][/td][td rowspan="4"][p]Completion time[/p][list][*][p]Under 5 min[/p][/*][*][p]5-10 min[/p][/*][*][p]Over 10 min[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Difficulty[/p][list][*][p]Easy[/p][/*][*][p]Normal[/p][/*][*][p]Hard[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Parkour[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Casual[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]PvE[/b][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p] [/p][h3][b]Additional Information[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The modes available in PUBG: Playgrounds are player-created content and are not official PUBG content. Due to the nature of community-created content, unexpected bugs may occur during play. If a critical bug is identified, access to the affected mode may be restricted.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]You must agree to the PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Mods Policy to use features such as Create to set up or join Custom Matches featuring player-created modes. However, matchmaking through PUBG: Playgrounds is available even if you have not agreed to the policy.[/p][list][*][p]The PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Mods Policy can be found under the Mods Policy tab at the link below.[/p][/*][*][p][u][url="https://pubg.com/clause/"]View the PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Mods Policy[/url][/u][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]If you encounter an issue while playing a mode or have any related questions, please contact [u][url="https://support.pubg.com/"]PUBG Support[/url][/u].[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]Jump into PUBG: Playgrounds and discover a wide variety of new modes![/p][p]PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Team[/p][p align="start"] [/p]

newsitems.author: JBowlerr
newsitems.contents: [p]Hello, PUBG Esports fans![/p][p align="start"]After two circuits in Seoul, the PUBG Global Series is moving to Shanghai, China. PGS Circuit 3, featuring PGS 7, PGS 8, and PGS 9, will take place across three weeks from August 5 to 23.[/p][p align="start"]Circuit 3 also marks the beginning of the second half of the 2026 PGS season—and from this point forward, the numbers change. Every series in Circuits 3 and 4 will award twice as many PGS Points as the first half of the season. With the race to PGC 2026 entering a decisive phase, here is everything you need to know about the next three weeks in Shanghai.[/p][p align="start"] [img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260720/TrzjbyVn.png" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: inline-block; float: none; margin-left: 5px; margin-right: 5px; min-width: 10px; vertical-align: bottom; text-align: center;"][/img][/p][h2]Circuit 3 Overview[/h2][list][*][p]Dates: August 5–23, 2026[/p][/*][*][p]Location: Shanghai, China[/p][/*][*][p]Participating Teams: 24[/p][list][*][p]12 Global Partner Teams[/p][/*][*][p]12 Regional Qualifiers[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Total Prize Pool: $500,000[/p][list][*][p]PGS 7: $100,000[/p][/*][*][p]PGS 8: $100,000[/p][/*][*][p]PGS 9: $300,000[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Match Start Time: 10:00 UTC daily[/p][list][*][p]PGS 7 Group Stage on August 5 begins at 05:00 UTC[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"]All matches except the PGS 7 Group Stage begin at 10:00 UTC (12:00 CEST / 17:00 ICT / 03:00 PDT).[/p][p align="start"]The PGS 7 Group Stage begins at 05:00 UTC on August 5 (07:00 CEST / 12:00 ICT / 22:00 PDT on August 4).[/p][p align="start"][/p][h2]Tournament Schedule[/h2][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,,"][tr][th][p]Series[/p][p][/p][/th][th][p]Date[/p][p][/p][/th][th][p]Stage[/p][p][/p][/th][th][p]Start Time[/p][p][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]PGS 7 [/p][/td][td][p]August 5 [/p][/td][td][p]Group Stage [/p][/td][td][p]05:00 UTC [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p] [/p][/td][td][p]August 6 [/p][/td][td][p]Winners Stage [/p][/td][td rowspan="8"][p]10:00 UTC[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p] [/p][/td][td][p]August 7 [/p][/td][td][p]Survival Stage [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p] [/p][/td][td][p]August 8–9 [/p][/td][td][p]Final Stage [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]PGS 8 [/p][/td][td][p]August 13 [/p][/td][td][p]Winners Stage [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p] [/p][/td][td][p]August 14 [/p][/td][td][p]Survival Stage [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p] [/p][/td][td][p]August 15–16 [/p][/td][td][p]Final Stage [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]PGS 9 [/p][/td][td][p]August 20 [/p][/td][td][p]Survival Stage [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p] [/p][/td][td][p]August 21–23 [/p][/td][td][p]Grand Finals [/p][/td][/tr][/table][h2][/h2][h2]Tournament Format[/h2][p align="start"]Circuit 3 follows a progressive stage system, with the results of each series determining how teams enter the next.[/p][h3]PGS 7 — August 5–9[/h3][list][*][p]Group Stage: All 24 teams are divided into Groups A, B, and C. Nine matches will be played, with each team competing in six.[/p][list][*][p]Top 16 → Winners Stage[/p][/*][*][p]Bottom 8 → Survival Stage[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Winners Stage: 16 teams compete in five matches.[/p][list][*][p]Top 8 → Advance directly to the Final Stage and receive Advantage Points[/p][/*][*][p]Bottom 8 → Survival Stage[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Survival Stage: 16 teams compete in five matches.[/p][list][*][p]Top 8 → Final Stage[/p][/*][*][p]Bottom 8 → Eliminated[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Final Stage: 16 teams compete across 10 matches over two days to determine the final PGS 7 standings.[/p][/*][/list][h3]PGS 8 — August 13–16[/h3][p align="start"]PGS 8 does not include a Group Stage. Teams are seeded directly according to their final PGS 7 standings.[/p][list][*][p]PGS 7 Top 16 → Winners Stage[/p][/*][*][p]PGS 7 Bottom 8 → Survival Stage[/p][/*][*][p]Following the Winners and Survival Stages, 16 teams advance to the 10-match Final Stage across two days.[/p][/*][/list][h3]PGS 9 — Circuit Final, August 20–23[/h3][p align="start"]Seeding for PGS 9 is determined by the PGS Points earned within Circuit 3 across PGS 7 and PGS 8.[/p][list][*][p]Top 8 in cumulative Circuit 3 PGS Points → Advance directly to the Grand Finals[/p][/*][*][p]Remaining 16 teams → Survival Stage[/p][/*][*][p]Survival Stage Top 8 → Grand Finals[/p][/*][*][p]Grand Finals: 16 teams compete across 15 matches over three days to crown the Circuit 3 champion.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Advantage Points[/h3][p align="start"]The top eight teams in the PGS 7 and PGS 8 Winners Stages receive Advantage Points, which are added to their standings at the start of the respective Final Stage.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,,,,,,,"][tr][th][p]Winners Stage At the end of PGS 12, the top eight teams in the annual PGS Points standings will qualify directly for PGC 2026.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]For the teams that built an advantage in the first half, Shanghai is where they must defend it. Each series also features separate match-win and MVP prizes.[/p][p align="start"]Across four circuits and 12 series, the total prize pool for the 2026 PGS season is $2,000,000.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]How to Watch[/h2][p align="start"]All PGS 7–9 matches will be broadcast live on official PUBG Esports channels.[/p][p align="start"]Matches begin at 10:00 UTC daily, except for the PGS 7 Group Stage on August 5, which begins at 05:00 UTC.[/p][p align="start"]Detailed broadcast channels and viewing links will be announced separately.[/p][p align="start"]A new city, double the points, and 24 teams fighting for their place at PGC 2026. Circuit 3 will set the direction for the second half of the 2026 season.[/p][p align="start"]See you in Shanghai on August 5![/p]

newsitems.title: Get Ready for the EWC 2026 Finals!
newsitems.author: Eoin
newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/91c2191b7915e4236a012041deff89637ce92ffc.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Get ready for the EWC 2026 Grand Finals![/h2][p align="start"]After three bombastic days of Group Stage action, it’s time to kick off the Grand Finals weekend of the Esports World Cup 2026! Over the course of three days, our top 16 teams will face off in front of a live audience in Paris, France for the chance to win a slice of the $2,000,000USD prize pool.[/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,,"][tr][td][p]MiTH[/p][/td][td][p]T1[/p][/td][td][p]Natus Vincere[/p][/td][td][p]Twisted Minds[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Team Falcons[/p][/td][td][p]Virtus.pro[/p][/td][td][p]17 Gaming[/p][/td][td][p]GAM Esports[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Team Liquid[/p][/td][td][p]Team Vitality[/p][/td][td][p]The Vicious Esports[/p][/td][td][p]Geekay Esports[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]AG.AL[/p][/td][td][p]FULL SENSE[/p][/td][td][p]Gen.G Esports[/p][/td][td][p]Shadow Esports[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]The Story so far[/b][/p][p align="start"]In Day 1, MiTH came out absolutely swinging with a dominant 79 point lead - although Twisted Minds, GAM Esports and Team Liquid followed close behind! [/p][p align="start"]
[/p][previewyoutube="3HJbmDawSUM;full"][/previewyoutube][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]On Day 2, [u][url="http://virtus.pro/"]Virtus.pro[/url][/u] became the stars of the show, converting a solid Day 1 performance into a smashing Day 2 - ending on top of the leaderboard on 85 points. 
[/p][previewyoutube="0C8RjKgX5AA;full"][/previewyoutube][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]With Day 3, the tides turned - the return of MiTH caused shockwaves for the rest of the lobby, with other Day 1 powerhouses (like Twisted Minds: especially impressive as the team is playing with coach TheTab instead of Lu due to visa issues) also showing up in a major way. Will MiTH remain the favourites for the Final, or will another team rise up and take the lead? It all depends on how they can adapt to the Grand Finals Smash Rule Format![/p][p align="start"][/p][previewyoutube="UqYJvHEiM90;full"][/previewyoutube][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Be sure to catch all the action live on [u][url="http://twitch.tv/pubg"]Twitch[/url][/u] and [u][url="https://www.youtube.com/@PUBGEsports/streams"]YouTube[/url][/u]![/p]

Stage will be played in the order of A&B, B&C, and A&C. Each group matchup features one match on Erangel, Miramar, and Taego, with every team competing in six of the nine total matches.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260720/wKBtKXmB.png" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: inline-block; float: none; margin-left: 5px; margin-right: 5px; min-width: 10px; vertical-align: bottom; text-align: center;"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]PGS Points — Double Points in the Second Half[/h2][p][/p][p align="start"]Circuits 3 and 4 award twice as many PGS Points as the first half of the season. The champions of PGS 7 and PGS 8 will earn 60 points each, while the PGS 9 champion will earn 120 points.[/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,,"][tr][th][p]Final Placement[/p][p][/p][/th][th][p]PGS 7[/p][p][/p][/th][th][p]PGS 8[/p][p][/p][/th][th][p]PGS 9[/p][p][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]1st [/p][/td][td][p]60 [/p][/td][td][p]60 [/p][/td][td][p]120 [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]2nd [/p][/td][td][p]48 [/p][/td][td][p]48 [/p][/td][td][p]96 [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]3rd [/p][/td][td][p]40 [/p][/td][td][p]40 [/p][/td][td][p]80 [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]4th [/p][/td][td][p]34 [/p][/td][td][p]34 [/p][/td][td][p]68 [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]5th [/p][/td][td][p]30 [/p][/td][td][p]30 [/p][/td][td][p]60 [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]6th [/p][/td][td][p]26 [/p][/td][td][p]26 [/p][/td][td][p]52 [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]7th [/p][/td][td][p]22 [/p][/td][td][p]22 [/p][/td][td][p]44 [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]8th [/p][/td][td][p]18 [/p][/td][td][p]18 [/p][/td][td][p]36 [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]9th [/p][/td][td][p]14 [/p][/td][td][p]14 [/p][/td][td][p]28 [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]10th [/p][/td][td][p]10 [/p][/td][td][p]10 [/p][/td][td][p]20 [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]11th [/p][/td][td][p]8 [/p][/td][td][p]8 [/p][/td][td][p]16 [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]12th [/p][/td][td][p]6 [/p][/td][td][p]6 [/p][/td][td][p]12 [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]13th [/p][/td][td][p]4 [/p][/td][td][p]4 [/p][/td][td][p]8 [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]14th–16th [/p][/td][td][p]2 [/p][/td][td][p]2 [/p][/td][td][p]4 [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]17th–24th [/p][/td][td][p]0 [/p][/td][td][p]0 [/p][/td][td][p]0 [/p][/td][/tr][/table][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]PGS Points are awarded only to the top 16 teams in each series. At the end of PGS 12, the top eight teams in the annual PGS Points standings will qualify directly for PGC 2026.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]For the teams that built an advantage in the first half, Shanghai is where they must defend it. For those chasing from behind, the doubled points create an opportunity to turn the standings around. One strong circuit could reshape the entire PGC race.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Map Pool and Order[/h2][p align="start"]Circuit 3 will be played across Erangel, Miramar, Taego, and Rondo.[/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,,,,"][tr][th][p]Stage[/p][p][/p][/th][th][p]Match 1[/p][p][/p][/th][th][p]Match 2[/p][p][/p][/th][th][p]Match 3[/p][p][/p][/th][th][p]Match 4[/p][p][/p][/th][th][p]Match 5[/p][p][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]Group Stage [/p][/td][td][p]Erangel [/p][/td][td][p]Miramar [/p][/td][td][p]Taego [/p][/td][td][p]— [/p][/td][td][p]— [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Winners / Survival / Final Day 1 / Grand Finals Days 1 & 3 [/p][/td][td][p]Erangel [/p][/td][td][p]Miramar [/p][/td][td][p]Taego [/p][/td][td][p]Rondo [/p][/td][td][p]Erangel [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Final Day 2 / Grand Finals Day 2 [/p][/td][td][p]Taego [/p][/td][td][p]Erangel [/p][/td][td][p]Rondo [/p][/td][td][p]Miramar [/p][/td][td][p]Taego [/p][/td][/tr][/table][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]The Group Stage repeats the same Erangel → Miramar → Taego order across all three group matchups for Matches 1 through 9.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Prize Pool[/h2][p][/p][p align="start"]The total prize pool for Circuit 3 is $500,000, distributed across the three series.[/p][list][*][p]PGS 7: $100,000 — $30,000 for the champion[/p][/*][*][p]PGS 8: $100,000 — $30,000 for the champion[/p][/*][*][p]PGS 9: $300,000 — $100,000 for the champion[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Placement prizes will be awarded to the top eight teams in PGS 7 and PGS 8, and to all 16 Grand Finalists in PGS 9. Each series also features separate match-win and MVP prizes.[/p][p align="start"]Across four circuits and 12 series, the total prize pool for the 2026 PGS season is $2,000,000.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]How to Watch[/h2][p][/p][p align="start"]All PGS 7–9 matches will be broadcast live on official PUBG Esports channels.[/p][p align="start"]Matches begin at 10:00 UTC daily, except for the PGS 7 Group Stage on August 5, which begins at 05:00 UTC.[/p][p align="start"]Detailed broadcast channels and viewing links will be announced separately.[/p][p align="start"]A new city, double the points, and 24 teams fighting for their place at PGC 2026. Circuit 3 will set the direction for the second half of the 2026 season.[/p][p align="start"]See you in Shanghai on August 5![/p]

newsitems.title: Dress Like a Champion: PGC 2025 Champion Set Released!
newsitems.author: Eoin
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/5ec7173e62c8a2d98694234feb172f0e768ae8dc.png"][/img][/p][p]Do you remember the Grand Finals of the PUBG Global Championship 2025 (PGC 2025) at the end of last year? On the highly competitive stage where the world's best teams clashed, Thailand's [b]FULL SENSE[/b] claimed the throne of World Champions with an outstanding performance.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Celebrate the PGC 2025 Champions, FULL SENSE![/b][/p][p align="start"]To honor their monumental achievement, the [b]PGC 2025 Champion Set: FULL SENSE[/b] is coming to the PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS store. The players of FULL SENSE directly participated in the design process to capture the team's iconic colors and identity, specially crafted to let you share in the pride of the PGC 2025 Champions.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]PGC 2025 Champion Set Items[/b][/p][list][*][p]FULL SENSE Helmet (Level 3)[/p][/*][*][p]FULL SENSE Backpack (Level 3)[/p][/*][*][p]FULL SENSE Vest (Level 2)[/p][/*][*][p]FULL SENSE Pan[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Sales Period[/b][/p][list][*][p]PC: July 15 – August 19 00:00 UTC[/p][/*][*][p]Console: July 23 – August 27 00:00 UTC[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]※ Notes[/b][/p][list][*][p]A portion of the sales revenue from this item set will be distributed to the PGC 2025 Champions, FULL SENSE.[/p][/*][*][p]The items are available for purchase on both PC and Console platforms.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Relive the roar and glory of PGC 2025. Show off your pride on the Battlegrounds with the FULL SENSE Champion skins![/p]
